newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-HALF-CENTURY FOR JADEJA AS INDIA CRAWL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HALF-CENTURY FOR JADEJA AS INDIA CRAWL.

text.p: Opener Ajay Jadeja hit an unbeaten half century but India made little effort to chase the victory target of 373 set by Sri Lanka on the last day of the second and final test on Wednesday.
Resuming at their overnight score of 49 without loss, India added only 45 runs while losing two wickets and went to lunch at 94 for two, leaving a further 279 needed off 62 overs to win.
Jadeja who had begun positively the previous day, racing to 35 off 50 balls, took a further 75 deliveries to add 21 runs to be unbeaten on 56 at lunch.
He reached his half-century in 153 minutes off 107 balls with eight fours.
Chaminda Vaas snapped up the wicket of Navjot Sidhu for 16, who edged a catch to Sanath Jayasuriya at second slip.
Rahul Dravid hung around for 69 minutes scoring only six before off-spinner Muthiah Muralitharan pushed one through quickly to have him caught off bat and pad by Marvan Atapattu at forward short-leg.
Skipper Sachin Tendulkar joined Jadeja and was unbeaten on seven at the break.
